**[P2] Avoid re-arming the flush currently in progress**

If `InsightExporter.flush()` re-enters `on_invocation_end`, `drain()` runs on the export worker and this request schedules another flush. An exporter that re-enters on every flush therefore keeps the worker flushing indefinitely after the invocation returns. Treat the current `_flush_in_flight` as sufficient when it covers this execution and no new record is pending; request another flush only for newly queued work. Add a flush-side re-entry test.
